vocabulary.meaning_en: to say what is bad or wrong about something
vocabulary.example: He criticized the food for being too salty.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say that someone or something is good
vocabulary.example: The teacher praised her hard work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who reviews films or books as a job; someone who finds fault
vocabulary.example: The film critic didn't like the ending.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a detailed review of a piece of work; to review it in detail
a person who expects the worst in every situation
vocabulary.example: A pessimist says, "It will rain soon."

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who believes people only do things for themselves
vocabulary.meaning_ar: شخص متهكّم يسيء الظن بدوافع الناس
vocabulary.note_ar: من الكلمة اليونانية بمعنى شبيه بالكلب
vocabulary.example: A cynic thinks you helped him only because you want something.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a passenger who keeps telling the driver what to do; anyone who gives advice they weren't asked for
vocabulary.meaning_ar: من يتدخّل في عمل غيره بالنصائح
vocabulary.example: Stop being a backseat driver and let me drive!

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say that someone or something has little value
to criticize someone very strongly and angrily
to say publicly that something is wrong or evil
a person who says nice things they don't really mean, to get something
vocabulary.example: Don't listen to him; he's a flatterer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who praises someone too much to please them
vocabulary.example: He's such a bootlicker with the boss.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clap your hands; to say you approve of something
to say something nice about someone
to tell someone you are happy about their success
vocabulary.example: I congratulated him on his new job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to praise someone highly, often in a speech after their death
vocabulary.example: His friends eulogized him at the funeral.

fine_lines.title: critic vs pessimist vs cynic
fine_lines.explanation_ar: critic: ينتقد أشياء معيّنة، وقد تكون وظيفته. pessimist: يرى الجانب السيئ في كل شيء. cynic: يظن أن الناس يفعلون كل شيء لمصلحتهم الشخصية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Critic: finds fault with certain things (can be a job). Pessimist: sees everything negatively. Cynic: thinks people only act for themselves.

examples.sentence: The critic said the film was too long.
My new car? The pessimist said it would break down.
The cynic said, "He only helped you because he wants something."

fine_lines.title: critic vs critique
fine_lines.explanation_ar: critic اسم فقط (شخص) بصوت قصير. critique اسم وفعل (مراجعة نقدية مفصّلة) بصوت i طويل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Critic is only a noun (a person), short vowel. Critique is a noun and a verb (a detailed review), long ee sound.

fine_lines.title: disparage vs lambaste vs denounce
fine_lines.explanation_ar: disparage: يقول إن الشيء بلا قيمة. lambaste: ينتقد بعنف وقسوة. denounce: يعلن أمام الناس أن الشيء خطأ أو شرّ.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Disparage: say it has little value. Lambaste: attack it very strongly. Denounce: say publicly it is wrong or evil.

examples.sentence: He disparaged my idea as useless.
The coach lambasted the team after the loss.

expressions.meaning_en: quick, active and up to date
expressions.example: Our new manager is really on the ball.

expressions.phrase: head and shoulders above the rest
expressions.example: This phone is head and shoulders above the rest.
This pizza is out of this world!
Why do you pick apart everything I do?

expressions.meaning_en: a person who is easily frightened
expressions.example: Jump in the water, don't be a scaredy-cat!

expressions.meaning_en: give false praise to get something
expressions.example: He's buttering up the boss because he wants a raise.

expressions.meaning_en: Saying nice things helps you get what you want.
expressions.example: You like my cooking? Flattery will get you everywhere!

expressions.meaning_ar: هذا أسوأ ما في الأمر / هذا فاق كل شيء
expressions.meaning_en: This is the worst (or most surprising) of all
expressions.example: He was late every day, but missing the big meeting really takes the cake.

expressions.meaning_en: a person you can't trust, who may hurt you secretly
expressions.example: Be careful of him; he's a snake in the grass.

questions.question: "Mr. E was ___ me up when he said I looked great." (false praise)
"You can't trust her. She's a ___."
questions.explanation_ar: snake in the grass = شخص غادر.
questions.explanation_en: Snake in the grass = can't be trusted.

questions.question: "This pizza is delicious. It's ___!"
questions.explanation_ar: out of this world = رائع جدًا.

questions.question: "Why do you ___ everything I do? It makes me feel bad."
Someone who thinks people do things only for themselves is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A cynic sees self-interest in everything.

questions.question: Someone who expects the worst in everything is a ___.
Which verb means "criticize very strongly and angrily"?
Which word can be BOTH a noun and a verb?
questions.explanation_ar: critique اسم وفعل، أما critic فاسم فقط.
questions.explanation_en: Critique is a noun and verb; critic is only a noun.

questions.question: "That hotel is ___; it's one of the best."
A passenger who keeps telling you how to drive is a ___.
